headline: Parks Commission to discuss dog ordinance rules, playground replacements, and the Comprehensive Plan update.
summary: The Parks Commission will review Appendix D, Section 7 of the dog ordinance, discuss playground replacements at Smalley, Baird, and Ethan Allen, and get an update on the Comprehensive Plan. The meeting also includes a public forum and standing reports.
